message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (fought on 18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **23,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing—across both sides.  In more detail:

| Side | Casualties (approx.) |
|------|----------------------|
| French & allied forces | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch, Prussian, and other Allied forces | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses.
